BiblicalUsage: Keluwlah means bridehood, the love of the espousals. Jeremiah 2:2 says God remembers the kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, when thou wentest after me in the wilderness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers our first love for him, and he calls us back to the wilderness road where we once followed close.
